sections.heading: 1. Gentle neck movers
lines: ③ Slow head turns side to side, 5 each way.
④ No pushing or twisting your head by hand.

sections.heading: 2. Call 000 if…
lines: Neck movement brings dizziness, a severe headache,
vision or speech changes, or numbness.

caption:
Mr Turtle cracks his neck even in the middle of meetings. Is that okay?

The pop is usually gas bubbles changing in the joint fluid, not bones moving back into place, and occasional self-cracking rarely causes problems. The catch is the relief tends to be brief, because the stiffness often comes from long hours in one position or tight surrounding muscles.

Instead of forceful twists, try chin tucks, shoulder rolls and slow head turns once an hour. If neck movement ever brings dizziness, a severe headache, vision or speech changes or numbness, call 000.
